name: glorieta
description: Study app for the Spanish driving theory test (permiso B), for English speakers with limited Spanish. Unofficial.
author: George Everitt

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && npm run types:worker && tsc --noEmit -p worker && vite build && node scripts/assert-no-secrets.mjs
scripts.test: node --test src/lib/*.test.ts worker/*.test.ts scripts/*.test.mjs && node scripts/test-schema.mjs
scripts.deploy: npm run check && npm run build && node scripts/assert-accounts.mjs && wrangler deploy
